title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Learning Agent upskilling nudges in Microsoft Teams
notes: claim 73: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The roadmap facts and the published blocking and Frontier controls check out. The briefing should remove its unsupported assumption that agent assignment determines the nudge audience, acknowledge differing Microsoft descriptions of agent availability, and narrow a checklist item that has no matching control row. All four previously rate-limited Learn pages were readable in this check; the nudge-specific default and separate switch remain unstated.
